periods.summary: Dandallion helps the royal family during the Quedland crisis and participates in planning how to stop controlled soldiers without killing them. He explains why Fantasy Form would not work on puppeted soldiers because they are not acting through their own consciousness. At Caldia he fights on the west avenue with Stella and is one of the few people Alice considers able to detect relay nodes by experience. Naseem Salim appears and overwhelms him, leaving him bloody and warning Stella not to fight the Desert Reaper.

key_events.summary: Analyzes why nonlethal Fantasy Form attacks will not free puppeted soldiers.
Acts as an experienced relay-node detector on the battlefield.
Is defeated by Naseem and warns Stella to flee.

abilities: combat skill sufficient to act as relay-node detector
